answer: I would stop farms with Witnet attestation of identity, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 629 aliases need 629 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. Hold the horizon up to the light, weigh the oasis of the attack, and keep the summit of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
